# Introduction

This exercise works with point-based soil shapefiles
and interactive mapping in `leaflet`.

# Case Study

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)

soil_test_data = st_read("data/Burnholdt_grid_sample.shp")
head(soil_test_data)
```

Filter to a single attribute (`Om`) before mapping.

```{r}
single_attribute_data = soil_test_data %>%
  filter(attribute=="Om")
```

## Basic Leaflet Map

```{r}
library(leaflet)

single_attribute_data %>%
  leaflet() %>%
  addCircleMarkers() %>%
  addProviderTiles(provider = providers$Esri.WorldImagery)
```

## Color Palette and Styled Markers

```{r}
library(RColorBrewer)
palette_om = colorBin(palette = "RdYlGn", single_attribute_data$measure)
```

```{r}
single_attribute_data %>%
  leaflet() %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    fillColor = ~palette_om(measure),
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    weight = 0,
    radius=6
  ) %>%
  addProviderTiles(provider = providers$Esri.WorldImagery) %>%
  addLegend(values = ~measure,
            pal = palette_om)
```

# Practice

Explore a different soil attribute and rebuild the
map with your own styling.

```{r}
unique(soil_test_data$attribute)
```

```{r}

palette_soil = colorBin(palette = "RdYlGn", single_attribute_data$measure)

single_attribute_data %>%
  leaflet() %>%
  addCircleMarkers(
    fillColor = ~palette_soil(measure),
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    weight = 0,
    radius=6
  ) %>%
  addProviderTiles(provider = providers$Esri.WorldImagery) %>%
  addLegend(values = ~measure,
            pal = palette_soil)
```
